verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an explicit 'Instructions for AI Agents' section. It tells agents to append `.md` to any page URL for clean Markdown, and the cited docs pages are themselves served as `.md`. It also points AI clients like Claude Code and Cursor to a docs MCP server; the probe's 404 came from a malformed double-`.md` URL, not a failure of the feature. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
